# SK9096 — An arrangement was reverted because an identifier now binds to something else

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A Skala bug by definition. An identifier that survived the rewrite resolved to a different symbol afterwards, so nothing was written and a reproduction was dropped under `.skala/crash/`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Tool |
| Default severity | error |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Safety layer 3 (docs/plan/06 § "Safety"). The rewritten code still compiles and now calls something else, which is the one class of damage a diff review is least likely to catch. Re-binding every surviving identifier and comparing the symbol is the only check that can see it.

## When it does not fire

None. A finding here is a bug in Skala.
